applies_to: the root of a CANALV2-style project (/home/binc/CANALV2_r3/CANALV2 on binc-PC; projects/desktop/CANALV2 here)
principle: One place for everything, one place to find everything. Numbered folders fix the reading order.

entries.name: 00_POLICY
entries.holds: one page per rule; 00_READ_ME.md is the index; structure_v###.md the master structure

entries.name: 02_SCRIPTS
entries.holds: tooling, one folder per tool; nodes/ComfyUI-BH-ShotPipe-v##/ is the node pack

entries.name: 03_INBOX
entries.holds: <shot>/ or <yyyy-mm-dd>_<topic>/, each with ENTRY.md (+ ASSETS.csv for shots)
entries.rule: nothing starts without an entry here

entries.name: 04_TRACKER
entries.holds: shots.csv, deliverables.csv, schedule.csv, attention-list.csv, queue/{in,running,done}/, run logs

entries.name: 90_DELIVERIES
entries.holds: <type>_<topic>_<yyyy-mm-dd>/, only what has gone out, versioned

entries.name: 99_ARCHIVE
entries.holds: superseded work, copied in; originals stay

entries.name: LEGACY_MAP.csv
entries.holds: where pre-project material lives and which shot links to it

rules: nothing is ever deleted; superseded work goes to 99_ARCHIVE
the official record (BH console, Slack, panama-console) wins over the tracker
